fact: A Justice Ministry official says the MOSIP-based digital ID pilot is anchored on birth registration and that 'we started with civil registration'.
source_slug: 2025-06-05 São Tomé and Principe pilots MOSIP-based national digital ID system

fact: Gleba TV reports that the digital identity initiative under the World Bank-financed STP Digital project foresees closer coordination between the civil registry, civil identification, migration and border services.
